from.place: Identical locally closed generators with an abstract coefficient ring

title: Locally closed module pieces over an abstract condensed ring
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring object in condensed abelian groups and T a scheme. Define a locally closed piece in the ordinary derived category of internal Λ_T-modules to be an object isomorphic to (i_*j_!P)[0], where i:Z→T is a closed immersion, j:U→Z is a quasi-compact open immersion, and P is a locally finitely presented internal Λ_U-module. The functors use the original canonical coefficient comparisons. No additional finiteness, noetherianity or field hypothesis is imposed. Specialization to the condensed finite coefficient field is definitionally the existing condensedConstructiblePiece predicate.
